description: Change an existing automation: its actions, conditions, trigger config or name, or switch it off with isActive false. Fields left out stay as they are; actions and conditions, when given, replace the whole list. Use it to fix an automation instead of creating a second one next to it. Get the id from list_automations.

actions.description: The full new list of actions (replaces the old one)

boardId.description: Board id the automation belongs to

conditions.description: Run only for rows that match, e.g. [{ field: "<column id>", operator: "equals", value: "New seller" }]

field.description: A column id on this board (from get_board_schema), or status, priority, title

operator.description: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, is_empty, is_not_empty, greater_than, less_than

isActive.description: false switches it off, true on

name: update_automation
